sophia: quick question — the new cost dashboard shows prefetch savings for tenant X as negative today, looks like we're charging them more after prefetched hits :confused:
cheng: saw this in morning pass, sounded like an aggregation bug in the 'savings normalization' step
matt: can you paste the tenant id / sample invocation? I'll pull traces
sophia: tenant: t-7391, sample inv: /v1/chat/generate/abc123 — console shows savings -$12.34 for the day (we expect positive)
elaine: negative savings usually means double-counting of baseline token cost or a missing cache credit when we split slabs
sophia: opened the econ panel and the per-token rows look weird — baseline tokens = 1200, cached tokens = 800, net billed tokens = 2000
ranj: hm that net line shouldn't exceed baseline + uncached; could be a join that duplicates cache rows when route remapping happened during rollout
cheng: here's the SQL we run for the savings delta (simplified):
```
SELECT tenant, sum(baseline_cost) as base, sum(actual_cost) as actual, base - actual as savings
FROM token_events
WHERE day = '$DAY' AND model IN ('mistral-v1','rwkv-lite')
GROUP BY tenant
```
cheng: note: cache credits are stored in separate table prefetched_credits, we left the left join as an inner join in the widget query until yesterday
matt: ah, inner join would drop rows for tenants with zero credits and could cause base/actual mismatch if we then add prefetched tokens later via a union
ranj: also saw an edge: when slabless-prefetch rollout flips routing policy, we sometimes generate a duplicate token_event (prefetch + hotpath) for same invocation id with different route tags
elaine: if UI aggregates by tenant then groups by invocation id later it can double count. two fixes: 1) dedupe by invocation_id in SQL, or 2) move prefetched credits into per-invocation join with coalesced credit value
sophia: what's lower-friction to ship for dashboard patch?
matt: quick hotfix: coalesce credits and dedupe by invocation_id in the view; that'll get numbers stable. follow-up: add integration test so we catch negative savings in daily ETL
cheng: patch ready, pushing to staging. query change:
```
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT invocation_id, tenant, sum(token_cost) as baseline, sum(prefetch_credit) as credit
  FROM token_events
  LEFT JOIN prefetched_credits USING (invocation_id)
  GROUP BY invocation_id, tenant
)
SELECT tenant, sum(baseline) as base, sum(baseline - coalesce(credit,0)) as actual, sum(base - actual) as savings
FROM inv
GROUP BY tenant;
```
ranj: pinging @cost-bot to run smoke on staging for tenant t-7391
cost-bot: [smoke-run] started test for tenant t-7391 on staging. ETA ~2m
cost-bot: [smoke-run] completed: savings today = +$11.87 (staging view). no negative values in tenant rollup sample :white_check_mark:
sophia: awesome, thanks all. can we add an alert if savings < -$1 for any tenant? i'd like a guardrail so product doesn't get surprised
matt: yup i'll file a small alert PR against observability rules, include owners eng-platform + cost-reports
cheng: will merge SQL hotfix and deploy to prod after one green canary
elaine: follow-up: we should document the dedupe rationale in the econ schema doc so it's clear why invocation_id is the canonical dedupe key
sophia: sounds good. leaving this thread open until prod deploy — thanks :heart:
